01

“so they have heads raised up [muqmahun]”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 36:8).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
so they have heads raised up [muqmahun] [Ya Sin 8] he said: "He says: raising their heads, with their hands placed on their mouths, meaning their shackles."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَهُمْ مُقْمَحُونَ [يس: 8] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: رَافِعُو رُءُوسِهِمْ، وَأَيْدِيهِمْ مَوْضُوعَةٌ عَلَى أَفْوَاهِهِمْ، يَعْنِي أَغْلَالَهُمْ "
Edition record 373149 · p. 559Link to report ↗
02

“And We have put before them a barrier”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 36:9).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And We have put before them a barrier [Ya Sin 9] meaning: "away from the truth, so they wander in misguidance."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا [يس: 9] ، يَعْنِي: «عَنِ الْحَقِّ فَهُمْ يَتَرَدَّدُونَ فِي الضَّلَالِ»
Edition record 373150 · p. 559Link to report ↗

05

“It was said, 'Enter Paradise'”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 36:26, 36:27).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
It was said, 'Enter Paradise' [Ya Sin 26] he said: "When he was told: 'Enter Paradise,'" he said: 'I wish ⦗p. 560⦘ my people could know of how my Lord has forgiven me and made me among the honored' [Ya Sin 27]: "that is when he saw the reward."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
قِيلَ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ [يس: 26] قَالَ: " لَمَّا قِيلَ لَهُ: ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ " قَالَ يَا لَيْتَ ⦗ص: 560⦘ قَوْمِي يَعْلَمُونَ بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ [يس: 27] «وَذَلِكَ حِينَ رَأَى الثَّوَابَ»
Edition record 373153 · p. 559Link to report ↗

08

“It is not for the sun to overtake the moon”

An explanation transmitted from al-Aswad (Q 36:40).

08
Explanation from al-Aswad 08

al-Aswad

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from al-Aswad:
It is not for the sun to overtake the moon [Ya Sin 40] he said: "He says: the light of neither precedes the light of the other, and it is not proper for them to do so"; nor does the night overtake the day [Ya Sin 40] He says: "they pursue each other swiftly, one stripping away from the other, and each runs on"; each in an orbit, swimming [Ya Sin 40] meaning: "running."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ،
لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنْبَغِي لَهَا أَنْ تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ [يس: 40] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: لَا يَسْبِقُ ضَوْءُ أحِدِهِمَا ضَوْءَ الْآخَرِ وَلَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُمَا ذَلِكَ "، وَلَا اللَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ [يس: 40] يَقُولُ: «يَطَّالِبَانِ حَثِيثَيْنِ يَنْسَلِخُ أَحَدُهُمَا مِنَ الْآخَرِ، وَيَجْرِي كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا» ، فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ [يس: 40] ، يَعْنِي: «يَجْرُونَ»
Edition record 373156 · p. 560Link to report ↗

11

“They will say, 'O woe to us! Who has raised us from our sleeping…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 36:52).

11
Explanation from Mujāhid 11

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
They will say, 'O woe to us! Who has raised us from our sleeping place?' [Ya Sin 52] he said: This is the saying of the disbelievers; and the believers ⦗p. 561⦘ will say that day: 'This is what the Most Merciful had promised' [Ya Sin 52], meaning "of what gladdened the believers; they say this at the resurrection."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا مَنْ بَعَثَنَا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنَا [يس: 52] قَالَ: " هَذَا قَوْلُ الْكُفَّارِ، فَقَالَ ⦗ص: 561⦘ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ يَوْمَئِذٍ: هَذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَنُ [يس: 52] "، يَعْنِي: «مِمَّا سَرَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، يَقُولُونَ هَذَا عِنْدَ الْبَعْثِ»
Edition record 373159 · p. 560Link to report ↗

“and he presents for Us an example”

19
Explanation from Mujāhid 19

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and he presents for Us an example [Ya Sin 78] he said: "He is Ubayy ibn Khalaf." [The entry breaks off here in the source edition.]
العربية
